text:
ajay: Heads-up — brought q4b-2.1-int8 into the canary yesterday and our promptset dedupe started failing on the longtail samples. Seeing duplicate fingerprints across holdout/golden buckets.

maria: ugh. how big is the leak? any numbers?

ajay: ~1.2% of golden set moved into unlabeled pool after ingest. Logs show hash mismatch during tokenization -> hash v2 vs v1. Sample:
```
prompt: "Summarize: The company acquired..."
old_hash: 0x8af3
new_hash: 0x7b11
```
Seems tied to tokenizer change when using optimized kernel for int8 path.

taylor: is this quantization or tokenization? int8 shouldn't affect tokenizer.

ajay: agreed but during compilation we switched to fused tokenizer path (tokenizer_v2) for perf. That path normalizes unicode differently. Repro steps:
```
python infra/ingest/hash_check.py --model q4b-2.1-int8 --sample 98765
```
outputs mismatch table.

sophia: tagging @labeling to pause auto-assignment to the affected buckets? @labeling-bot can you mute queue 'golden-auto'? :warning:

labeling-bot: Muting queue golden-auto for 1h. Reason: tokenization/hash mismatch (thread 3712345000)

maria: ok we need to do 3 things: (1) snapshot current golden and mark as read-only; (2) run an idempotent dedupe pass with tokenizer_v2 normalized hashes; (3) re-run the small eval harness to compare QA metrics between int8 and fp16.

taylor: I can run the dedupe script. Which config? tokenizer_v2 or the legacy?

ajay: use tokenizer_v2 and include fallback normalization flag --norm-unicode NFKC. Command:
```
./scripts/dedupe_run.sh --in samples/ingest/2026-03-21 --out work/dedupe-371 --tokenizer v2 --norm NFKC
```
Expected runtime ~12m for 100k samples.

sophia: labeling ops, please stop assigning any new golden relabels until we confirm dedupe. Also we'll need 200 relabel slots if dedupe moves things around.

maria: for evals: run these benchmarks: truthset A (golden snapshot), holdout-B (current unlabeled), and model pairs: q4b-2.1-fp16 vs q4b-2.1-int8. Metrics: exact-match, ROUGE-L, hallucination-rate. Use harness:
```
bench/run_eval.py --pairs 'fp16,int8' --sets 'truthA,holdoutB' --out reports/371
```

taylor: starting dedupe now. Posting progress to thread.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment q4b-2.1-int8 started by ajay @ 2026-03-21T12:14Z

taylor: 10k/100k processed — collision rate already trending to 0.9% -> stopping job to confirm with ajay.

ajay: hold. push a patch to tokenizer_v2 to preserve legacy normalization for punctuation; I'll push a quick diff then we re-run.

maria: after we stabilize, we should add a unit test to ingest pipeline that asserts stable fingerprinting across model compilation flags. Ticket me? I'll make a Jira: RED-ML-589.

sophia: also check batching behavior — different kernel selection changed whitespace trimming in a few cases. Add sample list:
- "What's the capital of   France?" -> extra spaces
- trailing newline on user prompts

labeling-bot: Noted 200 relabel slots requested, estimated ETA 3h.

taylor: dedupe run finished (exit 0). Results: 1.18% of golden overlapped; after applying normalization patch overlap reduces to 0.02%. Uploading report to GCS: gs://redwood-internal/eng-ml/reports/dedupe-371/report.html

maria: let's schedule a quick 15m sync to review the report and approve relabel. 14:45 PT? :calendar: 

ajay: +1. I'll include the small eval diffs. If int8 drift is <0.2% relative, we can proceed with canary promoting.

sophia: tagging @product-ops FYI — might impact SLAs for any customers on dedicated if we change tokenizer default.

taylor: thanks everyone. follow-ups: RED-ML-589 (unit test), RED-ML-590 (golden snapshot + relabel), dedupe report link above.

maria: closing loop: we should add a note in the onboarding checklist to run fingerprint-stability check when switching compilation flags. I'll update the docs.

ajay: thanks — will re-deploy patched canary in 30m and post results.

labeling-bot: Queue golden-auto unmuted (manual) by sophia

sophia: unmuted after we confirmed process. Good job :party-parrot:
